events.description: Married Mary Marguerite Prout (b. Plymouth c.1906, dau. of James Prout, carpenter, and Bertha Dunn), by Rev. D. W. McCarthy; licence no. 17091 sworn 25 Nov 1927. Groom of 19 Oak St, Wilkes-Barre. [R4-S1]

events.title: Marriage (2)
events.description: Married Alice Theressa Brennan (1907-1994) after Marguerite's death in 1934 (FS). [R4-S2]

bio: William Bernard McGuire, Kathryn's uncle, was a 21-year-old laborer at 19 Oak Street, Wilkes-Barre, when he applied to marry Mary Marguerite Prout of Lyndwood, Hanover Township, on 25 Nov 1927; they were married the next day by Rev. D. W. McCarthy, the same priest who married William F. Meier and Florence Pringle in 1926 ([R4-S1]). His application names his late parents James McGuire, born at Danville, Pa., and Anna Jones, born in England. Marguerite died in 1934; he remarried Alice Theressa Brennan in 1939, and died at Mountain Top in September 1975 ([R4-S2]; a GenealogyBank obituary index entry is attached there).
